source: GEBCO_2026 Grid, 15 arc-second ice-surface elevation (GEBCO Compilation Group 2026, doi:10.5285/4f68d5c7-45eb-f999-e063-7086abc036fa)
projection: azimuthal equidistant around the pole, units = degrees of latitude from the pole; pixel (i, j) centre X = (j + 0.5) * 2R / N - R, Y = R - (i + 0.5) * 2R / N; north lon = atan2(X, -Y), south lon = atan2(X, Y)
encoding: Terrarium RGB, lossless WebP: h = R * 256 + G + B / 256 - 32768 (metres)
